name: Bases Task Rows
changes: The Sponsor on GitHub button now opens the one-time payment tab of GitHub Sponsors.
tip: Type #next-action in "Count only tasks with tag" of a Task progress view to see which project notes have no next step.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Task Rows is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.

related.name: Kanban Embed
related.blurb: Use a Kanban board inside a project or daily note.

related.name: Task Field Labels
related.blurb: Show text labels for dates, priority, and recurrence in rendered tasks.

related.name: Task Date Links
related.blurb: Adds a real daily note link to a task when you complete it, so backlinks show what you finished each day.
